integrity: Fully self-contained proof and finite verification, without independent certification or claims of priority certainty.
limitations: Applies to synchronous three-predecessor majority on labelled binary rings of length at least five. Not a novel enumeration of the classical stable-word language. No generalization to arbitrary shifts, widths or stochastic updates, nor a first-entrance distribution. Priority relative to unindexed historical literature is unresolved.
title: Missing maximal individual periods in one-sided majority waves on binary rings
